items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: It was Ed, Benny, Henry, and James.

ctx.x: Oh, I didn't know. Oh, I heard he was no relation. Somebody told me he was no relation. I didn't know. Uh.

So, I should have known. I didn't know that they were related until after I had started to play music. And I met Andrew Kimball and Mrs. Margaret Kimball in Shreveport. And Bill Matthews, the trombone player, came to me and told me that he wanted to, that Mr. Kimball wanted to talk with me. And I went over and he asked me about, did I know my father's father? And I told him, yes, I know him. And he asked what was his name. I said his name was Henry Kimball also. That's your grandfather's name. Yes. And, uh, he…
Did the other brothers play any instruments?
